templates.titlePattern: Zero Dollars: {count} Hangs That Cost Nothing
templates.editorialBrief: Every card must describe a social activity that requires no admission and no purchase. Use official access information whenever possible, distinguish public access from student-only access, and avoid temporary promotions or vague affordability claims.
templates.exactTitle: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing

templates.titlePattern: {count} Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
templates.editorialBrief: Use real streets, blocks, corridors, or micro-districts within the practical orbit of this specific campus. Give exactly one sourced reason for each and do not substitute broad city neighborhoods, isolated businesses, safety claims, or demographic stereotypes.
templates.exactTitle: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
